an3.74:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Ānando Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an3.74:1.2: Atha kho Abhayo ca Licchavi Paṇḍitakumārako ca Licchavi yen' āyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu. Upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Abhayo Licchavi āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca:
an3.74:1.3: Nigaṇṭho bhante Nāthaputto sabbaññū sabbadassāvī aparisesaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paṭijānāti --
an3.74:1.4: carato ca me tiṭṭhato ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhitan ti.
an3.74:1.5: So purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā vyantibhāvaṃ paññāpeti, navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā setughātaṃ.
an3.74:1.6: Iti kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo dukkhakkhayā vedanakkhayo vedanakkhayā sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissati.
an3.74:1.7: Evam etissā sandiṭṭhikāya nijjarā visuddhiyā samatikkamo hoti.
an3.74:1.8: Idha bhante Bhagavā kim āhā ti. 2.
an3.74:2.1: Tisso kho imā Abhaya nijjarā visuddhiyo tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sammadakkhātā sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokapariddavānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthagamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya.
an3.74:2.3: Idha Abhaya bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkha- . . . pe (II.4.5) . . . samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu
an3.74:2.4: so navañ ca kammaṃ na karoti purāṇañ ca kammaṃ phussa phussa vyantikaroti
an3.74:2.5: sandiṭṭhikā nijjarā akālikā ehipassikā opanayikā paccattam veditabbā viññūhī ti.
an3.74:3.1: Sa kho so Abhaya bhikkhu evaṃ sīlasampanno vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . catuṭṭhajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an3.74:3.2: So navañ ca kammaṃ na karoti purāṇañ ca kammaṃ phussa phussa vyantikaroti
an3.74:3.3: sandiṭṭhikā nijjarā akālikā ehipassikā opanayikā paccattaṃ veditabbā viññūhī ti.
an3.74:4.1: Sa kho so Abhaya bhikkhu evaṃ sīlasampanno . . . pe . . . āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ ceto-vimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an3.74:4.2: So navañ ca kammaṃ na karoti purāṇañ ca kammaṃ phussa phussa vyantikaroti
an3.74:4.3: sandiṭṭhikā nijjarā akālikā ehipassikā opanayikā paccattaṃ veditabbā viññūhī ti.
an3.74:4.4: Imā kho Abhaya tisso nijjarā visuddhiyo tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sammadakkhātā sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokapariddavānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthagamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāyā ti. 3.
an3.74:5.1: Evaṃ vutte Paṇḍitakumārako Licchavi Abhayaṃ Licchaviṃ etad avoca:
an3.74:5.2: Kiṃ pana tvaṃ samma Abhaya āyasmato Ānandassa subhāsitaṃ subhāsitato nābbhanumodasī ti?
an3.74:5.3: Kyāhaṃ samma āyasmato Ānandassa subhāsitaṃ subhāsitato nābbhanumodissāmi.
an3.74:5.4: Muddhā pi tassa vipateyya yo āyasmato Ānandassa subhāsitaṃ subhāsitato nābbhanumodeyyā
